execution.driver: Temporary review-changes-only Python orchestration script; not retained as repository source.
execution.behavior_configuration: Target Skill in isolation with the case input and disposable fixture; a separate Codex grader received hidden assertions, additional requirements, the executor response, and any execution error.
execution.trigger_protocol: Select from installed names and descriptions, open each selected SKILL.md with a shell command, and count only the observed target read.
execution.isolation: Each Codex invocation used an isolated HOME while retaining the existing CODEX_HOME for authentication, preventing globally installed personal Skills from being discovered.
execution.grader: Separate Codex invocation with assigned hidden assertions and a JSON output schema.
execution.verdict_rule: Grade every assigned assertion. A failed critical assertion fails the case; a partial result with no critical failure makes the case partial.
execution.repetition: One matched behavior and trigger run per condition. The candidate passed every assigned assertion and trigger case, so another run was not decision-relevant.
